tasks.short: Prepare official statistical and individual medical reports

steps.what: Determine report scope, assess medical status and select verified source fields
Prepare report tables and form fields from the verified source pack
Verify reports, complete clinical statements and authorise release to the specified recipient

tasks.design: Configure the clinical record system {OTHER} to populate an existing report template from the source pack selected by the pediatrician. The pediatrician completes clinical conclusions, checks inclusion rules and approves the exact report in {DOCS} before releasing it through the required channel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified facts are copied between records and recipient-specific report forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting and template functions can reuse selected fields without interpreting the child's condition.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the correct population, making clinical statements and deciding what information may be disclosed.
tasks.human_edge: The pediatrician owns medical assertions and the appropriateness of disclosure.
tasks.altitude: More of report time goes to checking clinical meaning and less to copying already verified facts.

reach.task: Define report field provenance and correction handling
reach.learn: Report schemas, source identifiers and version control

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native report templates can copy verified fields and apply explicit count rules; the proposed task shares and savings need local measurement.
Juvoly drafts referral letters and suggests clinical codes. This is adjacent documentation capability, not evidence of automatic official-report completion or saved pediatrician reporting time.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and release of a requested report, not the original clinical encounter, diagnosis, workforce assessment or collection of missing vital-event data. Only report-specific selection and verification are counted here.

OTHER means clinical record system. In s1 the pediatrician produces recipient, purpose, reporting period, template version, selected record IDs, patient identifiers where authorised, event dates, verified event or diagnosis codes, inclusion criteria and source versions. For individual reports the pediatrician also determines the clinical statements; s3 retains writing and checking those statements.

Original event entries come from the responsible clinician, and workforce facts from the authorised personnel records owner, under existing unchanged recordkeeping. New report-specific capture and reconciliation are included in s1's full 35%; the software never invents missing source facts.

The records specialist verifies template field mappings, allowed categories and count rules before use, with 4 other-role hours per 100 focal baseline hours of ongoing upkeep. Unmapped, ambiguous or incomplete records return to the pediatrician for manual preparation; no model extraction or automatic medical-status decision is assumed.
Test native report export and merge configuration before custom code. Any already automatic report runtime has no removable human baseline; use the zero-saving scenario in that case.

The 8 incremental focal hours cover report-rule clarification, exceptions beyond normal s3 review and template-change checks. No new data collection is transferred to another role without counting it.
unknowns: Which report types the pediatrician actually prepares
Existing native exports, field completeness and submission requirements
National reporting rules and local release authority
research_questions: In a sample of real reports, how much time is field copying rather than assessment and checking?
Can a changed population rule or stale source version be detected before release?

already_counted.description: Source selection, clinical assessment and structured capture
Clinical text, source comparison and release approval

incremental.description: Changed rules, template checks and additional exception handling
Records specialist mapping and count-rule maintenance

approvals.approved_version: Exact report bytes, source-record versions, population rules, period, clinical statements, purpose and recipient checked in s3; any change voids release approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+0+25=60; gross 40%, minus 8 focal upkeep gives central net 32%. Conservative scenarios range from already automated forms with no new saving to source-complete recurring forms with only 26 points of copying removed and 8 upkeep. Clinical assessment and all release checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The pediatrician retains clinical reporting accountability while native templates reduce repeated copying.
reach: Work with medical records specialists on traceable report fields.
role.ambitious_version: Consistent, traceable reports with clinical conclusions still owned by the pediatrician.
